versions.subject: GUP LOLBIN Rules + Update AccCheckConsole Rule
versions.detection:
selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\gup.exe'
filter:
    Image|endswith: '\explorer.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: '\Notepad++\notepad++.exe'
condition: selection and not filter

versions.subject: fix: FPs (testing, and Windows 2022 test system)
versions.detection:
selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\gup.exe'
    Image|endswith: '\explorer.exe'
filter:
    Image|endswith: '\explorer.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: '\Notepad++\notepad++.exe'
filter_parent:
    ParentImage|contains: '\Notepad++\updater\'
filter_null:
    CommandLine: null
condition: selection and not 1 of filter*
versions.spl: ParentImage="*\\gup.exe" Image="*\\explorer.exe" NOT ((Image="*\\explorer.exe" CommandLine="*\\Notepad++\\notepad++.exe*") OR ParentImage="*\\Notepad++\\updater\\*" OR NOT CommandLine=*)
